The following events took place in '''5000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]] come to an end, with the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] united under [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta's]] rule.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[Marka Ragnos]], the reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], dies, prompting a [[Funeral of Marka Ragnos|duel]] between the rival [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Ludo Kressh]] and [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], who both seek to succeed Ragnos, as Ragnos's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] looks on.<ref name="Golden Age 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> Sadow ultimately persuades the [[Sith Council]] to anoint him the new Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="Golden Age 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>
*The [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]&mdash;a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire&mdash;erupts when two young hyperspace scouts, [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]], accidentally make contact with the Sith.<ref name="Atlas" />
*The Manderon Period ends.<ref name="Atlas" />
*Sadow instigates the Great Hyperspace War in hopes of conquering the Republic, invading major Republic worlds such as Coruscant and the Koros system along the [[Daragon Trail]] hyperlane.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[Holocron of King Adas]] is lost on the planet [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]] following the death of its owner, Lord [[Garu]].<ref name="Evil Never Dies">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>
*Sadow's forces are ultimately driven back when his forces are revealed to be largely illusions, and Sadow flees back to the Sith Empire, where he is confronted by Ludo Kressh.<ref name="Atlas" />
*Sadow escapes after destroying Kressh's fleet just ahead of a Republic fleet pursuing him, and ultimately finds refuge on the moon of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*The Sith starship ''[[Omen]]'' crashes on the remote planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], stranding its crew as the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], while its sister ship [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] is thrown into the future and arrives around [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>
*Supreme Chancellor [[Pultimo]] orders an invasion of the Stygian Caldera to wipe out the remains of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Atlas" />
*A [[Din supernova]] occurs in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], forming the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
*Csilla undergoes a [[great ice age]], blanketing its surface with glaciers and forcing the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] species to move underground. {{Circa}}<ref name="Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
*The symbol of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] is carved into the moon of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], earning it the name of the [[Mascot Moon]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Hearing">{{WEGCite|story=The Hearing|book=Dark Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
*[[Reaper's World/Legends|Reaper's World]] is colonized approximately around this time.<ref name="Elusive adventure">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
